# Using the Helium API

Source: https://heliumedu.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/159000431246

## Overview

Helium exposes a public REST API. Anything you can do in the iOS, Android, or web apps — view classes, add assignments, run a bulk import — is also available via the API. The full schema and authentication flow are documented in our [API docs](https://api.heliumedu.com/docs).

Helium does not maintain or support API tooling or pre-built integrations. We make the platform accessible so you can build your own, if interested. But Helium is open source on [GitHub](https://github.com/HeliumEdu), and technical contributors welcome — if you build something with the API and want to share it, reach out via [a ticket](https://heliumedu.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/new) and we'd be happy to consider promoting community integrations.
